Screen.description: Top-level page region — the surface a journey renders into.

Card.description: A bounded content container with surface, border, and radius.

Textarea.description: Multi-line free-text input (autosizing or fixed) for prompt/JSONL/long-form entry. Reused from VideoWorkspace's prompt field. (Briefly registered @ batches-workspace as a second consumer 2026-07-03; that composer was retired the same day per a scope correction — see DESIGN.md — so VideoWorkspace remains the sole consumer.)

AppSidebar.description: Collapsible navigation rail — brand header, grouped items, user footer.

DataTable.description: A sortable, paginated tabular data view built on the Table primitive.

ChartCard.description: A Card-wrapped data-visualization surface with token-driven series colors.

ThemeToggle.description: A control that switches the active theme (light/dark/system).

MessageThread.description: Scrollable multi-turn chat thread (overflow-y-auto), rendering the four UI states (loading/empty/error/success) with a scroll-to-latest control. New @ v40 chat-workspace-page (ref: ChatGPT/Claude/Vercel AI thread layout).

MessageBubble.description: A single chat turn — user (align end, primary fill) or assistant (align start, surface+border, markdown+code). Supports a streaming caret. New @ v40 chat-workspace-page.

Composer.description: Chat input — autosizing textarea + a Send/Stop action that toggles on streaming state, with a model-controls slot. New @ v40 chat-workspace-page.

CostReadout.description: Per-turn / per-session token+cost readout pill; shows an honest placeholder when usage is absent. Slot filled by chat-cost-readout. New @ v40.

ModelPicker.description: Catalog-model selector (source GET /v1/models). Slot filled by chat-model-controls. New @ v40.

ModelControls.description: Per-request controls (system prompt + temperature) feeding the composer. Slot filled by chat-model-controls. New @ v40.

SessionsRail.description: Left rail listing conversations grouped by recency — search + New + per-item (title, model badge, timestamp, active state). Restyles the v40 ChatHistorySidebar into the playground's session list. New @ chat-playground (ref: OpenAI Playground / ChatGPT conversation sidebar).

InspectorPanel.description: Right-side tabbed control surface (Parameters / Tools / Code) — the playground's parameter rail. Owns the relocated ModelControls + the new sampling/tools/code slots. New @ chat-playground (ref: OpenAI Playground right rail · Anthropic Console).

ParameterField.description: A labelled sampling control — label + slider (track/fill/thumb) + a numeric value box; also tag-input (stop sequences) and segmented variants. New @ chat-playground (ref: OpenAI Playground parameters: temperature/top_p/max_tokens/penalties/seed).

ToolCallCard.description: Renders an assistant tool/function call inline in the thread — function badge + call id, JSON arguments, the tool result panel, then the final answer. New @ chat-playground (ref: OpenAI tool_calls · Anthropic Console tool use).

ConversationTopBar.description: Conversation column header — editable title + model selector + Fork/Export/View-code actions + running CostReadout chip. New @ chat-playground (ref: OpenAI Playground top bar).
